topic: Heitz GGX visible normal VNDF sampling vs full-NDF firefly spike rig
topic_zh: Heitz GGX 可见法线椭球采样（VNDF）对比朴素全 NDF 掠射角萤火虫噪点爆炸
scope: Deterministic Eric Heitz (JCGT 2018) GGX Visible Normal Distribution Function (VNDF) ellipsoid-cap importance sampling (W_VNDF = G2/G1 <= 1.0000 with alpha = 1.00) versus naive Walter 2007 full-NDF cosine sampling (W_NDF = 1/G1(V) = (1 + sqrt(1 + alpha^2*tan^2(theta_v)))/2) and 64-trial visible normal quadrature across 17 grazing view angles (theta_v in [0 deg, 80 deg]).

robustness.name: Sampled 17 viewing angles guarantee 100% visible normals (V.H > 0) and unit-bounded Monte Carlo weights

good_fit: Real-time ray-traced reflections in UE5 Lumen, Unity HDRP, Blender Cycles, and WebGPU/Three.js path tracers
Stretching the GGX ellipsoid to the unit sphere to sample only camera-visible normals (V.H > 0)
Canceling (V.H) / ((N.V)*G1(V)) in the PDF so estimator weights never exceed 1.0000 at grazing angles
Eliminating the 1.5000x at 60° and 3.3828x at 80° firefly variance spikes of full-NDF D(H)*(N.H) sampling
not_for: Purely analytic direct-light point evaluations without Monte Carlo importance sampling
Perfect delta mirrors with alpha == 0 where reflect(-V, N) requires only 1 deterministic ray
